summary: Enhance your water utility's resilience with our comprehensive training on organizational climate strategies. Equip your team for a sustainable future today!
lede: Organizational Climate Resilience for Water Utilities provides a structured approach to anticipating, preparing for, and adapting to climate volatility while managing aging infrastructure. You will learn to integrate climate risk into capital planning and daily operations, assess impacts, and combine Nature-Based Solutions with gray infrastructure. The course develops practical skills in scenario modeling, risk-adjusted asset management, Global Climate Model downscaling, and ISO 14091 impact assessment methodologies. You will also design stakeholder communications and Adaptive Management Pathways that support flexible decisions, stronger investment cases, and long-term operational and financial resilience.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals responsible for the long-term viability and operational continuity of water, wastewater, and stormwater systems.
audience: Climate Adaptation Specialists focused on municipal water
modules: Hydrologic Risk and RCP Scenario Modeling
Resilient Asset Management and Lifecycle Analysis
Digital Twins and Smart Water Technology
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in water utility management, civil engineering, or environmental planning. Familiarity with basic asset management principles and hydrologic concepts is required. Pre-reading on the ISO 14090 standard is recommended.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
